title: Mishy Mash Court
style: Mandarin pop with Spanish-tinged electropop, brisk four-on-the-floor and syncopated handclaps; verse stays tight with rubbery bass and sparse plucks, pre-chorus builds with filtered sweeps and snapped percussion, chorus opens into bright synth stabs and chanty doubles. Lead vocal is close-mic and playful, with stacked hooks, quick ad-libs, and little Mandarin/Spanish callouts; reverse swells and ping-pong delay throws lift the ends of key lines. Crisp, glossy, and punchy., pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle says, "Set your feet"
Ruby's already on the line
Quick hands, quick eyes, quick grin
She cuts the court in half, real fine

Michelle says, "Wait for me"
Ruby shakes her head and moves
Too fast, too hot, too sure
"Coach, I got my own groove"

[Pre-Chorus]
No, no, we don't match
You want slow, I want snap
你说稳一点
I say, "Nah, I attack"

[Chorus]
Mishy mash, mishy mash
Michelle, I don't like that
Mishy mash, mishy mash
Ruby brings it right back
Sí, sí, no me frenes
太快, 太快, baby
Mishy mash, mishy mash
We clash, then we play

[Verse 2]
Michelle taps the paddle once
Ruby goes and takes the court
Slices like a paper cut
Then laughs like it's a sport

"Turn your wrist," Michelle says
Ruby spins it all away
"You coach one way," Ruby says
"I win my own way"

[Pre-Chorus]
No, no, we don't match
You want calm, I want flash
你说慢一点
But I’m gone in a dash

[Chorus]
Mishy mash, mishy mash
Michelle, I don't like that
Mishy mash, mishy mash
Ruby brings it right back
Sí, sí, no me frenes
太快, 太快, baby
Mishy mash, mishy mash
We clash, then we play

[Bridge]
One step left, one step right
We argue through the rally
Michelle wants clean and neat
Ruby's all zigzag alley

Then the ball skips low
And we both laugh, "Okay"
Different hands, same fire
Same court, same day

[Final Chorus]
Mishy mash, mishy mash
Michelle, I don't like that
Mishy mash, mishy mash
Ruby brings it right back
Sí, sí, no me frenes
太快, 太快, baby
Mishy mash, mishy mash
We clash, then we play

Mishy mash, mishy mash
Michelle, I don't like that
Mishy mash, mishy mash
Ruby brings it right back
Sí, sí, no me frenes
太快, 太快, baby
Mishy mash, mishy mash
We clash, then we play
